sourceText:
Pomegranate and Fruit Couscous
By: Pom Wonderful
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:37pm

Ingredients




Couscous

1 cup arils from 1–2 large POM Wonderful pomegranates
1 1/2 cups dry instant couscous
3 cups water
1/2 teaspoon salt
1 tablespoon vegetable oil
1 cup red or green seedless grapes, cut in half
1 cup clementine sections
3/4 cup green onion, chopped
1 1/2 cups celery, chopped
Dressing

 cup white wine vinegar
1 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper
1/2 cup olive oil
1/2 cup pistachios, chopped
1/4 cup fresh mint, chopped

Preparation

1 Couscous: 2 Score 1–2 fresh pomegranates and place in a bowl of water. Break open the pomegranates under water to free the arils (seed sacs). The arils will sink to the bottom of the bowl and the membrane will float to the top. Sieve and put the arils in a separate bowl. Reserve 1 cup of the arils from fruit and set aside. (Refrigerate or freeze remaining arils for another use.) 3 In a medium saucepan over medium-high heat, bring 3 cups water to a boil. Add salt and oil. 4 Stir in couscous and cover; remove from the heat and let stand 5 minutes. 5 Fluff with a fork and add prepared grapes, clementines, green onion and celery. 6 Add arils and fluff with a fork. 7 Dressing: 8 In a blender or food processor, mix vinegar, salt, black pepper, and fresh mint; stir to mix. 9 Add olive oil and pistachios and process to combine; add chopped mint. 10 Stir and pour over couscous. 11 Toss and serve at room temperature.

About


Nutrients Per Serving (1 cup): 448 calories (48% calories from fat, 45% calories from carbs), 9g protein, 55g carbohydrates, 26g total fat (3g saturated), 0mg cholesterol, 624mg sodium, 5g dietary fiber, 55mcg vitamin A RE, 21mg vitamin C.
